description:
Searches the topic vocabulary seminars are tagged with.

Use this to turn a customer's wording into a filter value for
`seminars_search`, and to check whether a product or technology is
covered at all. Aliases are searched too, so "K8s" finds "Kubernetes" and
"AKS" finds "Azure Kubernetes Services".

This is a filter axis, not a catalogue: a hit means the topic exists, not
that a seminar on it does. `seminars_search` answers that.

query.description: Part of a topic name or alias, e.g. "Kubernetes"

type.description: One of manufacturer, topic, technology, software, software_version, audience

name: seminar_topics
title: Search topics
